for dir in /data/*/; do
  [ -d "$dir" ] || continue
  echo ">>> Pruning $dir"
  RESTIC_REPOSITORY="$dir" restic forget \
    --keep-hourly 24 \
    --keep-daily 5 \
    --keep-weekly 4 \
    --keep-monthly 3 \
    --prune \
    --verbose
done
🏰 Expelliarmus those Creepers! Happy spelunking, witches and wizards of Hogwarts! ✨
